description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between translation quality, measured by BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy), and latency, measured by Average Lagging (AL), in a Wait-k Policy for machine translation. The x-axis represents the Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, also on a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 32. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different combination of consistency and machine translation models. The red line with star markers, labeled "Consistency-Bi," shows a steady increase in BLEU score as latency increases, starting at approximately 26 and reaching around 32 at an AL of 8. The purple dashed line, labeled "Inconsistency-CE," also shows an increase in BLEU score with increasing latency, starting at around 22 and reaching about 30 at an AL of 8. The blue dashed line, labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP," follows a similar trend, starting at approximately 24 and reaching around 29 at an AL of 8. The green line with square markers, labeled "Consistency-CE," begins at around 20 and increases to about 28 at an AL of 8. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of changes in translation quality with respect to latency.
